description: This Java class defines a set of constant string values used for messaging paths and identifiers within the Eclipse Ditto service's 'things' model. It includes paths for actors, streaming, snapshotting, and cluster configuration, encapsulated in an immutable utility class.

classes.name: ThingsMessagingConstants
classes.description: A final utility class containing constant string paths and identifiers used for messaging within the 'things' model in Eclipse Ditto.
